text: Over the past four years, Walnut has grown so much and together we have accomplished a lot. This is why I have decided to run for re-election to the Walnut City Council, and I would be honored to earn your support.

By working closely with our Sheriff's Department, we have helped reduce crime and kept our neighborhoods safe. Crime in our city is trending down over the last four years. We have welcomed new developments, small businesses, and restaurants that have brought new energy and economic activity to our city. However, our work as a city is never done. If re-elected to the city council, I promise to:
Continue and strengthen our partnerships with public safety agencies
Create more opportunities and programs for families and seniors
Ensure that every tax dollar is used wisely, transparently, and with thoughtful care
Protecting the character of our community through smart, intentional development

Walnut is an amazing place to live in, and as your councilman I have fought for our residents to keep it that way. I would be honored to earn your support once again. Vote for Ritchie Cajulis for Walnut City Council.

text: Age: 59
Occupation: Business Owner
Dear Walnut Residents,
It is a great honor to run for Walnut City Council. I am committed to serving our community with integrity, transparency, and accountability while putting residents first.

As a small business owner, licensed clinical social worker, community leader, and nonprofit volunteer, I have dedicated my career to helping individuals, families, and our community overcome challenges through compassion, collaboration, and practical solutions. These experiences have strengthened my ability to listen, bring people together, and make thoughtful decisions.

I will work to maintain safe neighborhoods, support responsible economic development, protect our city's financial stability, improve essential city services, and encourage open communication between residents and City Hall. I believe every voice matters, and our local government should be accessible, responsive, and transparent.

Walnut is a wonderful place to live, work, and raise a family. I am committed to preserving our high quality of life while planning responsibly for the future. Together, we can build a stronger, safer, and more vibrant community for current and future generations.
I would be humbled and grateful to earn your trust, your support, and your vote.
— Dr. Hong Diana Zhao, LCSW

text: Age: 45
Occupation: Office Manager

My name is Stefanie Leilua, and I am running for Walnut City Council. As a proud resident for over ten years and a single parent of five wonderful children, I am deeply invested in our community. My two youngest children attend Walnut High School as an incoming freshman and sophomore, and my second-eldest daughter serves as the assistant coach for the WHS cheerleaders.

My commitment to Walnut is proven. I served as the Walnut NJB Administrator for five years and volunteered as a coach for over seven. Through these roles, I have had the privilege of watching out local children grow into remarkable young adults. I love our city, and I am running to ensure the current and future generations continue to thrive in Walnut.
